verdict.rationale: Okta documents Cross App Access (XAA), built on OIDC, for secure agent-to-app connections. It is pitched as letting an AI app act for a user without exposing credentials while admins keep control, which is Okta's own mechanism for brokering agent access. However, the evidence never explicitly describes issuing scoped or least-privilege API credentials (OAuth scopes, token restrictions, per-agent permissions), so the depth of least-privilege support is unproven. The XAA material is blog and playground content, not reference docs. missing for 10: explicit documentation of scope or permission restriction on agent-issued tokens, least-privilege controls for agent credentials, reference-level docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
